title: Bintang Lima Buat Istri
subject: a Depok ojek driver who spends his one Sunday off taking his wife out on the same motorbike, giving her the full app-style service (spare helmet, mask, 'sesuai titik ya, Bu?') and at the end giving her five stars out loud
caption: Indonesian new wave synth-pop, 80s-style dance pop. Analog polysynth playing bright staccato chord stabs, chorus-drenched clean guitar with choppy offbeat strums, rubbery eighth-note synth bass, LinnDrum-style drum machine with gated snare and handclaps. Glossy 80s production with gated reverb, clean and punchy mix. Warm playful male mid-register vocal, clearly sung melody with light backing harmonies in the chorus. 122 BPM, D major. Mood of a sweet Sunday joyride. No trap hi-hats, no autotune, no EDM drops, no rap, no modern pop ballad piano.
lyrics:
[Intro - polysynth stabs, gated drums]
[Verse 1]
Enam hari aku antar orang
Minggu ini aplikasi kumatikan
Helm cadangan sudah kucuci
Penumpangku cuma kamu hari ini
[Pre-Chorus]
Masker, Bu? Jaket, Bu?
Mau lewat jalan pintas atau santai?
[Chorus]
Bintang lima buat istri
Pegang pinggang, jangan sungkan
Nggak usah bayar, nggak usah tip
Cukup senyum di spion kanan
[Verse 2]
Kita mampir beli es doger
Kamu suruh aku putar dua kali
Sesuai titik ya, Bu Rina?
Kamu tertawa, cubit perutku lagi
[Pre-Chorus]
Masker, Bu? Jaket, Bu?
Tujuan akhir, rumah kita sendiri
[Chorus]
Bintang lima buat istri
Pegang pinggang, jangan sungkan
Ulasan bilang sopirnya genit
Tapi dia boleh antar lagi besok
[Outro - synth bass and handclaps fade]
Bintang lima, Bu
Bintang lima
